dialog.cancelNote: Cancel this request? Requests with recorded receipts require financial correction first.
dialog.completeNote: Confirm the final service amount and commission. This creates customer receivables and the technician's share; it does not move cash.
dialog.noTechnicians: Add a technician in team management before assigning this request.

empty: No orders in this queue. Orders appear here as their workflow progresses.

errors.invalidAmount: Enter a positive whole service amount and a commission between zero and the service amount.
errors.invalidData: Check the visit date, time, and request details.
errors.invalidTransition: This action is not allowed at the current workflow stage.
errors.stale: The request changed while this action was open. Close it and try again from the current queue.

flow: Request → accept → assign → repair → company collects → technician settlement
paymentNote: Completing a repair does not record a payment. Customer receipts, company commission, and technician payouts remain separate.

active.description: Start scheduled visits and finalize the service amount when the repair is complete.
active.title: Visits and repairs

archive.description: Cancelled requests and completed jobs with no outstanding customer or technician balance.
archive.title: Closed requests

assignment.description: Choose a technician and agree a visit date and time for accepted requests.
assignment.title: Awaiting assignment

collection.description: Record full or partial payments received by the company for completed services.
collection.title: Customer payment

inbox.description: Review the customer's request, then accept it or cancel it.
inbox.title: Incoming requests

settlement.description: Customer payment is complete. Pay the technician's share after keeping the company's commission.
settlement.title: Technician settlement

saved: Changes saved. The queues now reflect the current order and payment balances.
search: Search by request ID, customer, phone, appliance, or technician
storageError: Browser storage is unavailable. Current changes will not survive a reload.
